reason: A is more actionable and grounded because it specifies an NbMoTaW reference, an alloying intervention, temperature-dependent measurements, and prior evidence that Ti or V additions affect relevant properties. It remains weakened by unsupported quantitative targets and an internally inconsistent claim of V precipitation strengthening in a required single-phase alloy, but B is less viable because it names no specific B2-forming composition, cites no support, and assumes—without a sound basis—that coherent B2 precipitates will improve rather than reduce ductility.
